content: Dependency for DcmDspDidControlMaskSize DcmDspDidControlMaskSize larger than 4 shall be only allowed if DcmD- spDataUsePort is set to USE_DATA_ASYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER , USE_DATA_- ASYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER_ERROR or USE_DATA_SYNCH_CLIENT_SERVER . Note: ControlEnableMask larger than 32 bits is a very rare use case. Therefore the Dcm supports only C/S interfaces to solve this use case.
